cells.value: Build independent generative hierarchies first; then compare structure, generation rules, trait inheritance, counts, and failure residuals across systems.
cells.raw_value: Build independent generative hierarchies first; then compare structure, generation rules, trait inheritance, counts, and failure residuals across systems.

cells.value: Earlier classes constrain later possibility spaces; whole available classes define alternatives; particular configurations realize descendants; sequence changes what becomes possible.
cells.raw_value: Earlier classes constrain later possibility spaces; whole available classes define alternatives; particular configurations realize descendants; sequence changes what becomes possible.

cells.value: Any materially identifying intrinsic quality, purpose, function, role, occurrence, association, nature, relationship characteristic, or archetypal-to-mid-level tale/legend.
cells.raw_value: Any materially identifying intrinsic quality, purpose, function, role, occurrence, association, nature, relationship characteristic, or archetypal-to-mid-level tale/legend.

cells.value: Archetypal → High → Mid. Low-level narrative minutiae remain in sources unless they recur or prove structurally necessary.
cells.raw_value: Archetypal → High → Mid. Low-level narrative minutiae remain in sources unless they recur or prove structurally necessary.

cells.value: Sethian ≠ Valentinian; Hesiod ≠ later Greek harmonizations; primary Upanishadic text ≠ later commentary.
cells.raw_value: Sethian ≠ Valentinian; Hesiod ≠ later Greek harmonizations; primary Upanishadic text ≠ later commentary.

cells.value: Keep peer count, subgroup count, pair count, total represented components, and cumulative trait count separate.
cells.raw_value: Keep peer count, subgroup count, pair count, total represented components, and cumulative trait count separate.

cells.value: Similarity raises attention, not truth. A useful anchor should preserve role/function/lineage/transition, not just names or numbers.
cells.raw_value: Similarity raises attention, not truth. A useful anchor should preserve role/function/lineage/transition, not just names or numbers.

cells.value: Hesiodic Greek + Sethian + Valentinian + early Upanishadic. Sound/color/physics return after the first ontology scaffold.
cells.raw_value: Hesiodic Greek + Sethian + Valentinian + early Upanishadic. Sound/color/physics return after the first ontology scaffold.

cells.value: Added Philolaus/Pythagorean, Plato, Nicomachus, Ptolemy, Boethius, Fludd, Kepler, plus Aristotle as a 4→5 regime-boundary comparator.
cells.raw_value: Added Philolaus/Pythagorean, Plato, Nicomachus, Ptolemy, Boethius, Fludd, Kepler, plus Aristotle as a 4→5 regime-boundary comparator.

cells.value: Ptolemy explicitly compares the Greater Perfect System with the 12-sign zodiac and bends the musical line into a circle by identifying endpoints.
cells.raw_value: Ptolemy explicitly compares the Greater Perfect System with the 12-sign zodiac and bends the musical line into a circle by identifying endpoints.

cells.value: Kepler supplies 6 planets × 2 extrema = 12 termini, but each planet continuously traverses the states between its endpoints.
cells.raw_value: Kepler supplies 6 planets × 2 extrema = 12 termini, but each planet continuously traverses the states between its endpoints.

cells.value: Fludd's monochord puts elements, planetary spheres, fixed stars and upper regions on one proportional line with nested octave/fifth/fourth relations.
cells.raw_value: Fludd's monochord puts elements, planetary spheres, fixed stars and upper regions on one proportional line with nested octave/fifth/fourth relations.

cells.value: Do not treat repeated numbers as identity. Preserve whether a number is a peer count, pair count, endpoint count, face count, partition, resolution, or container.
cells.raw_value: Do not treat repeated numbers as identity. Preserve whether a number is a peer count, pair count, endpoint count, face count, partition, resolution, or container.

cells.value: Public polemic is evidence of what an author chose to say publicly, not automatically a complete record of private intent. Keep public claim, built structure, private correspondence, and later interpretation separate.
cells.raw_value: Public polemic is evidence of what an author chose to say publicly, not automatically a complete record of private intent. Keep public claim, built structure, private correspondence, and later interpretation separate.

cells.value: Secret collaboration is currently unsupported; genuine polemic and adversarial co-development both fit the evidence well. A partially performative polemic remains possible but requires positive private evidence.
cells.raw_value: Secret collaboration is currently unsupported; genuine polemic and adversarial co-development both fit the evidence well. A partially performative polemic remains possible but requires positive private evidence.

cells.value: Direct letters, manuscript provenance, pre-publication exchange, shared cipher/key, unique cross-dependencies, or private admissions would materially change the secret-coordination hypothesis.
cells.raw_value: Direct letters, manuscript provenance, pre-publication exchange, shared cipher/key, unique cross-dependencies, or private admissions would materially change the secret-coordination hypothesis.

cells.value: Complementary structures can emerge from sincere disagreement. We do not need 'cahoots' for the exchange to function as a distributed collaboration.
cells.raw_value: Complementary structures can emerge from sincere disagreement. We do not need 'cahoots' for the exchange to function as a distributed collaboration.

cells.value: Concrete lead: in 1621 both Fludd's Veritatis Proscenium and Kepler's Prodromus/Mysterium reissue used Frankfurt printer Erasmus Kempffer, though for different publishing patrons (de Bry vs Tampach). The 1622/23 replies continue through these overlapping channels.
cells.raw_value: Concrete lead: in 1621 both Fludd's Veritatis Proscenium and Kepler's Prodromus/Mysterium reissue used Frankfurt printer Erasmus Kempffer, though for different publishing patrons (de Bry vs Tampach). The 1622/23 replies continue through these overlapping channels.

cells.value: This materially strengthens 'they had rapid access to each other's work / shared book-trade intermediaries.' It does NOT by itself strengthen 'secretly coordinated message' very much; printers commonly served multiple intellectual camps.
cells.raw_value: This materially strengthens 'they had rapid access to each other's work / shared book-trade intermediaries.' It does NOT by itself strengthen 'secretly coordinated message' very much; printers commonly served multiple intellectual camps.
